description: Lists the input and output formats actually served by the Jam Jam API right now (GET /formats), with their limits (maxBytes, maxPages, maxDurationS) and whether they require an account or Premium. Call this FIRST, before jj_convert_file or jj_convert_text, to know which output ids are valid for a given input. Pass "input" to get the exact list of possible outputs for that one input format. Needs no API key.

input.description: Restrict the response to the possible outputs from this input format id (as returned by a previous call without "input"). Adds `possibleOutputs` to the result.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for any localized labels, e.g. "fr".

name: jj_list_formats
title: List conversion formats
